quirks.summary: Portal URL and vendor come from PlanIt's directory; neither the vendor nor any retrieval step has been verified against this portal.
quirks.detail: PlanIt reports scraper_type 'Idox'. That label is a hint, not a finding - it is recorded elsewhere in this skill as stale at one authority and wrong at another. Fingerprint the portal before choosing a recipe, and set portal.vendor_verified when you have.
quirks.workaround: Run the vendor detection signatures in vendors.json against the portal before applying any recipe.

quirks.summary: Recorded vendor was 'idox-public-access'; the portal fingerprints as 'def-atrium'.
quirks.detail: The previous value came from PlanIt's scraper_type, which is a directory label rather than a finding. The fingerprint is taken from the portal's own markup.
quirks.workaround: Apply the def-atrium recipe, not the idox-public-access one.

quirks.summary: WAF signals present (cloudflare) but the landing page served normally.
quirks.detail: Passive at survey time. Not a reason to avoid the automated route; it is a reason to pace properly and to expect a challenge if you do not.

Search and detail worked; the sampled application had no downloadable documents, or they are linked by a pattern Recipe A does not match. One application sampled, so a signal rather than a verdict. Several of these are minerals-and-waste county authorities, where a July application may genuinely carry nothing.
quirks.workaround: Sample a second application before concluding.
